defects.effect: A live but hung daemon is indistinguishable from a healthy daemon.
The helper can report success while the queue remains unprocessed.
A newly visible daemon process is accepted without a fresh heartbeat or queue scan.
The helper receipt always writes task_claimed=false and does not wait for priority-1 claim.
Exit code zero proves invocation only, not recovery, heartbeat freshness or claim.
The local preflight receipt can remain absent remotely until a later runner publish succeeds.

required_holder_owner_changes: Read the canonical daemon heartbeat and apply a bounded freshness threshold.
When a daemon process exists but heartbeat is stale, fail closed or perform the approved single-daemon recovery action.
After start, require a fresh heartbeat with matching process identity and branch.
Require priority-1 queue scan or claim evidence before declaring recovery successful.
Publish operator and restart receipts with commit, push and remote readback.
